name: SPACE MARINES: ASSAULT INTERCESSORS
description:
Assault Intercessors are among the most widespread close-support units in a Chapter's arsenal. Firing their heavy bolt pistols as they close upon the foe, they charge into the fray, where they make short work of their enemies with brutal swings of their chainswords.

Fight at the Front

This multipart plastic kit builds 10 Assault Intercessors, aggressive close combat warriors for your Space Marines armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. Armed with a brutal Astartes chainsword, they can hack their way through enemy infantry, making them a perfect choice for an aggressive commander.

A Variety of Violence

The Assault Intercessors can be built as 1 large unit of 10, or 2 units of 5 warriors each with their own optional sergeant. The sergeants can each replace their standard armament with a power sword, power fist, or thunder hammer, and a hand flamer or plasma pistol. They also have a choice of two heads – bare or helmeted. The Intercessors have a choice of interchangeable parts, and there are options to build narrative poses – throwing a grenade, reloading a bolt pistol, or holding a combat knife.

The kit includes these interchangeable parts:
– 12 right-armed heavy bolt pistols
– 10 left-armed Astartes chainswords
– 10 helmeted heads
– 18 bare heads (of 9 designs)
– 10 pistol holsters
– 10 sheathed combat knives
– 30 cosmetic accessories, including pouches, purity seals, and reliquaries

Contents:
– 214 plastic components
– 10 Citadel 32mm Round Bases
– 1 Space Marine Infantry Transfer Sheet
– 1 construction guide

The Space Marine Infantry Transfer Sheet features 757 high-quality waterslide transfers. These include Ultramarines, Imperial Fists, Salamanders, and Raptors Chapter symbols, battlefield role identification, numerals, and more for you to decorate your miniatures.

These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
